# GitHub Configuration

This directory contains GitHub-specific configuration for the Knowledge Intelligence Platform.

## Contents

- **workflows/** — Continuous integration and automation pipelines

## Purpose

GitHub Actions workflows validate code quality on every push and pull request. Additional templates for issues and pull requests may be added as the project grows.
